limits: Only named v230/v229 artifacts and prior v227 review were read. No RepoQA, reserve, private Gold, engine implementation or model was opened.
No engine, model, benchmark, fit, producer or test was run. No criteria, labels, queries, rankings or earlier reports were edited. Only this review receipt was written.

This is a conclusion-to-evidence consistency review, not a fresh audit of all 1000 source bytes, AST classification or worker execution. Those claims remain attributed to supplied closed receipts; their metadata/hash chain is consistent.

Original aggregate Recall/NDCG, mapping/evidence faithfulness, AST duplicate search, query character/token counts, broad pool size range and intent heuristic implementation were not independently recomputed in this pass. The stage counts, all recorded RRF arithmetic and supplied provenance bindings were checked independently.

Neither 18 public pilot cases nor one exposed-query representation control measures generalization, aggregate causal adapter loss or native repository accuracy. No useful-context judgment is converted into a relaxed official hit.
